rust_summary: a smithing or crafting-grid result with its inputs, which a mod may replace or clear (`native_prepare_smithing_v2`, `native_prepare_item_craft_v2`).
doc_summary: `native_prepare_smithing_v2(player, name, pos, template, base, addition, result)` and `native_prepare_item_craft_v2(player, name, pos, grid, result)` give a mod the inputs of a smithing table or crafting grid and the result, which a mod may replace or clear (`None`) even when vanilla made it; the earlier hooks hear only a table with no result. Bundles need "hooks": @API:prepare_craft_v2@.
